title: Int.odd_iff_nat_abs_odd : forall n, Iff (Odd n) (Nat.Odd (natAbs n))
statement: For every n : Int, Int.Odd n holds iff Nat.Odd (Int.natAbs n) holds. Named, discoverable API surface for what Int.Odd's own definition (F:int-odd) already gives for free: both directions of the Iff are the identity function, since the two sides are the SAME term up to one delta unfold of Int.Odd.

formal.statement: theorem Int.odd_iff_nat_abs_odd : ((x0 : Int) -> Iff (Int.Odd x0) (AxNat.Odd (Int.natAbs x0)))
